WARMD_AGENT(8) System Manager's Manual WARMD_AGENT(8)

NAME

warmd_agent — general helper tool

SYNOPSIS

warmd_agent

DESCRIPTION

warmd_agent is a helper tool for OS X.

There are no configuration options to warmd_agent. Users should not run warmd_agent manually.
